listingTitle: Keep synchronous Node I/O out of async code
title: Keep synchronous Node I/O out of async code
why: Synchronous filesystem calls block the Node event loop and delay unrelated requests and tasks while I/O completes.
suggestion: Use fs.promises or the callback API and await completion instead of calling a Sync filesystem method.
limitations: Only named or namespace imports and CommonJS requires from fs or node:fs are resolved.
Wrappers, reassigned bindings, dynamic imports, and synchronous APIs from other modules are not inferred.
